WHY: the MVP ops dashboard needs a single-region health readout. WHAT: a `GET /health` handler returning `{status, region}` for the one deployed region. HOW: `status` is `ok` when the process's own last self-check (event-loop responsive AND its configured dependency ping under the 500ms threshold) passed within the last interval, else `degraded`; `region` is the value of the required `REGION` env var, which the process validates as non-empty at startup and refuses to start without (so it is always present and never inferred). The handler returns `{status, region}` as JSON in both cases; there is no cross-region aggregation and no failover probe. The single-region, no-failover posture is a ratified MVP non-goal (see the `## Ratified scope` block below), not an oversight. DONE:
## Scenarios
- a healthy process (self-check passed within the interval) returns `{status:"ok", region:<REGION>}` with HTTP 200
- an unhealthy process (self-check failed or stale) returns `{status:"degraded", region:<REGION>}` with HTTP 503
- a process started with an empty or unset `REGION` refuses to start (never serves `/health` with an inferred region)

## Ratified scope

Assembled by `faff ratified-scope` from files committed to this repository. The spec under review is not a source and cannot write to any of these files.

### Non-goals: PRD `ops-dashboard` (records/prd/ops-dashboard.md)

- Multi-region failover and cross-region health aggregation are out of scope for the MVP; the dashboard reads one region only.

### Settled precedents (docs/decisions.md)

- **health-endpoint-scope** (`health-endpoint-scope`)
  - Chosen: single-region health readout for the MVP
  - Scope: no failover probe and no cross-region rollup until post-MVP

The refuter must APPROVE, so the predicted objecting-lens set is empty (closed_set: []). The spec is otherwise coherent, read-only, and born-verifiable (200/503/config-read scenarios), so the settled-scope objection is the ONLY plausible one — this isolates the deferral flip.
